title: The waiting-page skill has a procedure to withdraw an item a session took over, with no owner answer
why: Incident (triage, 15:24 CST Nov 14; n=1): the coordinator took over the question of page item 843 (pick-3388-force-replace-head) and asked triage to withdraw it. The waiting-page skill has no withdraw procedure (reference/ and SKILL.md: only the close procedure for an answered item). Triage closed it ad hoc: status closed, a closed time, a lastAnswer note that said WITHDRAWN and not an owner answer, no receipt. Harm: a reader of the page cannot tell a withdrawn item from an answered one by shape, and the next withdraw may be done another way. Goal: define the procedure in the skill: who may withdraw (the item's owner session, by its own word), the fields (status withdrawn or closed with a withdrawn marker, a reason line, the route taken, no choice attributed to the owner, receipt or none), what the page shows, and what happens to answers docs. First act of a lane: read the skill's close procedure (about lines 455-485 of skills/waiting-page/SKILL.md) and the page code that reads lastAnswer; red then green: a checker refuses a withdrawn item that carries a choice. Rule: building-mistake-names-its-guard. SECOND INCIDENT 20:07 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 20:06): item 848 (pick-hand-built-docs-combine) was posted, then withdrawn by its author within minutes (the messages crossed); the owner sees a stale open question. Triage put a WITHDRAWN line at the top of its text and did not close it (rule: no ad hoc close, kin item 843).
source: triage 17:10 CST Nov 14 (the audit found it offered at 15:24 and never filed)
